name: Marlon Kranz
lede: Software engineer in Hamburg. I build distributed, enterprise-scale cloud services in Java at Adobe, and open-source projects in Go and TypeScript.
statement: I build backend services and cloud architecture, and I enjoy a good interface when a project needs one, like this site.

At Adobe I own and plan the migration of a production pipeline, one of my team's biggest efforts, and on the side I'm active in the team's AI setup, from its harness to the shared repo of agent skills.

Beyond work I build my own tools: devline, the Claude Code plugin I use every day, and Dux Player, a music player, and I'm a core contributor to Dux Shell, a Linux desktop shell. My bachelor thesis at the University of Hamburg is a tool too: BPMNscript, a text language for business processes. The B.Sc. in Information Systems, with an exchange year at San Diego State University, is expected in December 2026.
